title: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director

quotes.text: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced that effective immediately, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board.
quotes.for: Nvidia announcement reinstating Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director effective immediately.

quotes.text: The Board of Directors voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang following a series of discussions and meetings with Mr. Huang, after which the Board was satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead NVIDIA.
quotes.for: Unanimous board vote after meetings satisfied directors regarding Huang candor and leadership.

quotes.text: In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk.
quotes.for: Input from senior levels of the U.S. government and board confidence of no national security risk.

quotes.text: The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers,
quotes.for: Board chair Harvey C. Jones statement on stakeholder interests.

quotes.text: We are grateful to Colette Kress for her outstanding service as interim CEO, in addition to her continuing responsibilities as NVIDIA’s Chief Financial Officer.” Harvey Jones will remain as Board chair.
quotes.for: Colette Kress continuing as CFO and Harvey C. Jones remaining board chair.

quotes.text: I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment. I want to thank the NVIDIA Board for its confidence and deliberation through this process.
quotes.for: Jensen Huang statement on returning with humility and renewed commitment.

quotes.text: The Board reiterated that the committee’s investigation will proceed to conclusion. Mr. Huang fully supports the investigation and is committed to cooperating with it.
quotes.for: Independent board committee investigation proceeding to conclusion with Huang cooperating.

quotes.text: The Board also recently formed a National Security and Export Control Committee comprised solely of independent directors to oversee trade compliance and national security risks.
quotes.for: National Security and Export Control Committee overseeing trade compliance and security risks.

quotes.text: NVIDIA is commencing a search to fill a new position, Chief Compliance Officer, to oversee compliance across NVIDIA and report to the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee. NVIDIA will continue to cooperate with ongoing government investigations and inquiries.
quotes.for: Search for a Chief Compliance Officer and continued cooperation with government inquiries.

title: NVIDIA Corporation Current Report on Form 8-K

quotes.text: On November 22, 2026, the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation reinstated Jen-Hsun Huang as NVIDIA’s President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board of Directors, effective immediately.
quotes.for: Form 8-K recording the board vote date as November 22, 2026.

quotes.text: Following the reinstatement of Mr. Huang, Ms. Kress will continue to serve as NVIDIA’s Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.
quotes.for: Colette Kress continuing as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.

title: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang. 'It's wrong, and it's shocking,' California AG Bonta says

quotes.text: Huang resigned as Nvidia’s chief executive on Nov. 12, after reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a Singapore-based businesswoman suspected by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy.
quotes.for: November 12 resignation after reports of extramarital affairs and suspected intelligence ties.

quotes.text: “No national security risk? Based on what?” Sen. John Cornyn (R-Texas) wrote on X.
quotes.for: Republican Senator John Cornyn questioning the national security conclusion.

quotes.text: On Dec. 1, Huang is scheduled to testify in closed-door meetings with three Republican-led congressional committees.
quotes.for: December 1 closed-door testimony before three House committees.

quotes.text: On Monday, Republican Sen. Tim Scott, chairman of the Senate Banking Committee, announced that Huang would also testify in a public hearing on Dec. 3 titled “Protecting America’s AI Advantage: Oversight of U.S. Export Controls.”
quotes.for: December 3 Senate Banking Committee public hearing on export controls.

quotes.text: Meanwhile, in California, Atty. Gen. Rob Bonta said that the state Department of Justice would continue its investigation into whether confidential information or advanced chips were sent to China as well as whether Nvidia issued statements that misled investors or the public.
quotes.for: California Attorney General Rob Bonta continuing state DOJ investigation into Nvidia.

quotes.text: “It’s wrong, and it’s shocking,” Bonta said of Huang’s reinstatement.
quotes.for: Rob Bonta calling Huang reinstatement wrong and shocking.

title: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO

quotes.text: “The NVIDIA Board of Directors has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO,” Trump wrote on Truth Social.
quotes.for: Trump Truth Social post calling the reinstatement the correct and proper decision.
